item.description: The shortlist for The Unwin Award 2026 has been announced, recognising non-fiction writers in the early stages of their careers whose work has made a significant contribution to the world. item.title: Bright new chapter for Earlesfield as affordable homes take shape
item.description: Land on the edge of one of Grantham’s biggest housing estates is being transformed into 21 new homes for people on the Council’s housing register. item.title: Cold health alert issued for Lincolnshire as temperatures set to plunge
item.description: An urgent cold health alert has been issued for Lincolnshire and the wider East Midlands, with officials warning of an increased risk to life as temperatures are forecast to drop sharply this week.
